name: Introduction to Engineering I
description: Introduction to engineering problem-solving, design, and teamwork.
prerequisiteText: Restricted to eligible first-year/exploring/transfer engineering majors; requires a drill component and an approved concurrent math course.

name: Composition I
description: Practice in academic writing, research, drafting, and revision.
prerequisiteText: Writing placement or qualifying scores apply; some students must take ENGL 00001 as a pre- or corequisite.

name: University Chemistry I
description: Introductory chemistry covering atoms, bonding, reactions, and energy.
prerequisiteText: Requires qualifying math preparation or placement/test scores; a drill component is a corequisite.

name: Calculus I
description: Derivatives and their applications, plus an introduction to integrals.
prerequisiteText: MATH 12003 or MATH 13004 with a C or better, or qualifying placement, ACT/SAT, or AP results; drill component required.

name: Introduction to Engineering II
description: Further engineering problem-solving and team design, including selecting an engineering major.
prerequisiteText: GNEG 11101 or GNEG 111H1; engineering first-year/exploring engineering major restriction; math course and drill corequisites.

name: Calculus II
description: Integral calculus of one variable and infinite series.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24004 with a grade of C or better; drill component corequisite.

name: University Physics I
description: Calculus-based mechanics, waves, temperature, and heat.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24004 prerequisite for non-PHYS majors (pre- or corequisite for PHYS majors); lab component corequisite.

name: Technical Composition II
description: Technical writing for different audiences, purposes, and communication settings.
prerequisiteText: ENGL 10103 or equivalent.

name: Principles of Biology
description: Foundational biology including evolution and interactions among living systems.
prerequisiteText: BIOL 10101 laboratory corequisite.

name: Principles of Biology Laboratory
description: Biology laboratory observation and experimental methods.
prerequisiteText: BIOL 10103 lecture corequisite.

name: University Chemistry II
description: Chemical equilibria, kinetics, thermodynamics, solutions, and electrochemistry.
prerequisiteText: CHEM 14103 or specified alternatives/proficiency; qualifying math preparation; CHEM 14201 and drill corequisites.

name: University Chemistry II Laboratory
description: Chemistry lab covering measurements, interpretation, and experiments.
prerequisiteText: CHEM 14203 lecture and related drill component corequisites.

name: Physical Geology
description: Survey of geological processes, landforms, materials, and resources.
prerequisiteText: GEOL 11101 laboratory corequisite.

name: Physical Geology Laboratory
description: Identify minerals and rocks, interpret maps, and conduct geology field exercises.
prerequisiteText: GEOL 11103 lecture pre- or corequisite.

name: University Physics II
description: Continuation of calculus-based physics with electricity, magnetism, and optics.
prerequisiteText: For non-PHYS majors: PHYS 20304 and MATH 25004 prerequisites; lab component corequisite. For PHYS majors, MATH 25004 may be concurrent.

name: History of the American People to 1877
description: Survey of American political, social, and economic history through 1877.
prerequisiteText: No listed course prerequisite.

name: History of the American People, 1877 to Present
description: Survey of American history from 1877 through modern periods.
prerequisiteText: No listed course prerequisite.

name: Programming Foundations I
description: Introduction to software development in C++, including program design, testing, variables, control flow, functions, arrays, files, and classes.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24005 or MATH 24004 with a C or better; eligible academic program status; lab component corequisite.

name: Digital Design
description: Digital logic and computer hardware fundamentals, including logic gates, finite-state machines, sequential circuits, and hardware description languages.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24005, MATH 24004, or MATH 240H4 with a C or better; eligible academic program status; lab component corequisite.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Introduction to sets, logic, proofs, relations, algorithms, counting, graph theory, trees, and Boolean algebra.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24004 with a C or better, or equivalent.

name: Programming Foundations II
description: Continuation of C++ programming and problem solving, including data structures, object-oriented programming, recursion, and algorithms for searching and sorting.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 20004 with a C or better; eligible engineering program status; lab component corequisite.

name: Computer Organization
description: Relationship between computer hardware and software, including CPU design, processor organization, and computer performance.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 21104 with a grade of C or better; lab component corequisite.

name: Linear Algebra
description: Systems of linear equations, vector spaces, linear transformations, matrices, and determinants.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24004 or MATH 22003, with a grade of C or better. Only one of MATH 30803 and MATH 30903 may count for credit.

name: Programming Paradigms
description: Programming across object-oriented, network, and event-driven paradigms, with an introduction to languages and concurrency.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 20104 or DASC 21003, with a grade of C or better; restricted to eligible engineering students or CSCE minors.

name: Operating Systems
description: Introduction to operating system structures, process management, storage, files, and distributed systems.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 20104 and CSCE 22104, each with a grade of C or better.

name: Engineering Probability and Statistics
description: Engineering applications of probability distributions, statistical inference, regression, and experimental design.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24005 or MATH 25104 or MATH 24004; drill component is a corequisite.

name: Ethics and the Professions
description: Professional ethical issues in engineering, business, and other fields, approached through moral theories and questions of justice and rights.
prerequisiteText: No course prerequisite listed in the 2026–27 catalog.

name: Software Engineering
description: Software development practices, engineering tools, modular programming, and collaborative design.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003, each with a grade of C or better.

name: Database Management Systems
description: Relational databases, data modeling, SQL, indexing, transactions, and database security.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 with a grade of C or better; cannot also receive credit for CSCE 55203.

name: Combinatorics
description: Counting methods, inclusion-exclusion, and generating functions with other combinatorial topics.
prerequisiteText: MATH 26103 or MATH 28003; plus MATH 30803 or MATH 30903 as a pre- or corequisite.

name: Public Speaking
description: Preparing, organizing, and delivering presentations; audience analysis, listening, and speech critique.
prerequisiteText: No course prerequisite listed in the 2026-27 catalog.

name: Capstone I
description: First phase of a two-semester software capstone project, including concept development and project planning.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 36103 or CSCE 361H3; at least 72 completed credit hours. CSCE 35103 is a pre- or corequisite.

name: Algorithms
description: Formal analysis of algorithm complexity and major classes of computer science algorithms.
prerequisiteText: (CSCE 31903, CSCE 319H3, or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better) and (MATH 26103 or MATH 28003).

name: Computer Networks
description: Introduction to computer networking using Internet protocols, architectures, and implementation concepts.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3, each with a grade of C or better.

name: Capstone II
description: Second semester of the comprehensive undergraduate capstone project, including implementation and presentation.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 45601.

name: Formal Languages and Computability
description: Formal languages, finite automata, grammars, Turing machines, computability, and complexity.
prerequisiteText: (CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3, grade C or better) and (MATH 26103 or MATH 28003).

name: Basic Course in the Arts: Architecture Lecture
description: Introduction to architecture, the built environment, and how buildings and cities relate to people and technology.

name: Basic Course in the Arts: Art Lecture
description: Introduction to visual arts, including artistic ideas, criticism, and examples of artwork.

name: Basic Course in the Arts: Film Lecture
description: Introduction to film as art, including composition, sound, lighting, editing, and performance.

name: Experiencing Music
description: Introduction to musical styles, listening skills, and connections between music and culture.

name: Introduction to Cultural Anthropology
description: Introduction to culture, social organization, human behavior, and cultural change.
prerequisiteText: Drill component required as a corequisite.

name: Communication in a Diverse World
description: Introduction to effective communication across interpersonal, group, organizational, and intercultural contexts.

name: Introduction to Comparative Politics
description: Survey of political systems and comparative political analysis.

name: American National Government
description: Introduction to American national government, its structure, institutions, and political processes.

name: General Psychology
description: Introduction to psychological science, including learning, cognition, development, personality, and behavior.

name: Principles of Macroeconomics
description: Introduction to national income, employment, growth, fiscal and monetary policy, and business cycles.
prerequisiteText: MATH 11003 or higher, or qualifying ACT or SAT mathematics score; credit restrictions with AGEC 21003 apply.

name: Programming Challenges
description: Methods for solving programming competition problems using algorithms, data structures, and mathematical techniques.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 with a grade of C or better.

name: Data Mining
description: Data preparation, pattern discovery, predictive models, clustering, and scalable data mining algorithms.
prerequisiteText: (CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003), OR (CSCE 20104 and INEG 23303 and INEG 23104), OR (CSCE 20104 and STAT 30133 and STAT 30043).

name: Concurrent Computing
description: Concurrent programming, distributed architectures, parallel systems, and algorithms for concurrency.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better.

name: Big Data Analytics and Management
description: Distributed data processing, scalable analytics, streaming data, and machine learning on large datasets.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better.

name: Cryptography
description: Modern cryptography, symmetric and public-key techniques, authentication codes, and digital signatures.
prerequisiteText: (CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better) AND (MATH 26103 or MATH 28003).

name: Software Architecture
description: Design, evaluation, and tradeoffs of software architectures illustrated with real systems.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 41303 and CSCE 35103.

name: Information Retrieval
description: How search systems organize, index, rank, and retrieve text information.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 with a grade of C or better.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: Intelligent agents, search, reasoning, knowledge representation, and applications of AI.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better.

name: Mobile Programming
description: Software development principles and practical application building for mobile devices.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 with a grade of C or better.

name: Cloud Computing and Security
description: Cloud computing architectures, scalable services, cloud application development, and security risks.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 36103 or CSCE 361H3 with a grade of C or better.

name: Computer Graphics
description: 2D/3D graphics models, transformations, cameras, lighting, and graphics programming.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 with a grade of C or better.

name: Information Security
description: Security principles, policies, threats, vulnerabilities, cryptography, and intrusion detection.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 31903 or CSCE 319H3 or DASC 21003 with a grade of C or better.

name: Composition II
description: Writing and rhetoric, using genre to communicate with different audiences.
prerequisiteText: ENGL 10103 or equivalent.

name: Principles of Statistics
description: Introductory statistics, probability, and data-based decision making.
prerequisiteText: MATH 11003 or MATH 11103 with at least C, or qualifying placement/test score.

name: Technical and Professional Writing
description: Technical writing, document design, usability, and professional communication.
prerequisiteText: ENGL 10103 and ENGL 10203 or equivalent.

name: Calculus III
description: Multivariable differential and integral calculus, including vector calculus.
prerequisiteText: MATH 25004 with a C or better; drill corequisite.

name: Elementary Differential Equations
description: First- and second-order differential equations, Laplace transforms and systems of equations.
prerequisiteText: MATH 25004 with a C or better; drill corequisite.

name: System Synthesis and Modeling
description: Hardware-description and modeling languages for digital computer system design.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 22104 with a C or better.

name: Circuits & Electronics
description: Fundamentals of electrical and electronic circuits and devices for non-electrical-engineering majors.
prerequisiteText: MATH 25804 and PHYS 20404.

name: Embedded Systems
description: Architecture, software and hardware of embedded control systems.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 22104 with a C or better; lab corequisite.

name: Computer Architecture
description: Modern processor architecture, instruction scheduling, parallel computing and memory hierarchies.
prerequisiteText: CSCE 22104 with a C or better.

name: Transition to Advanced Mathematics
description: Proofs, abstract concepts, set theory, logic, relations and functions.
prerequisiteText: MATH 24004 pre- or corequisite.

name: Introduction to Partial Differential Equations
description: Separation of variables and transform methods for partial differential equations.
prerequisiteText: MATH 25804 and MATH 26004, each with C or better.
